items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Then I have percussion. (Sue Evans, you saw her?)?

ctx.x: But I was behind in my payments and the guy came with a big bruiser and walked in my apartment without even knocking and repossessed that thing. Can you believe that? I could sue them I think because it's illegal to do that. To walk into an apartment. And Anita was in the kitchen cooking and she heard this noise and she didn't have any clothes on. She didn't know there was going to be anybody in the house. She heard this noise and she peeked around and here's Wallace (Zeir?) and his bruiser, his accomplice and…
Then I have percussion. (Sue Evans, you saw her?)?
Yes. Where did you find her?
